name: Devam Kumar
headline: I architect enterprise platforms, build AI agents, and engineer backend systems that scale.
subtitle: Solution Architect · AI Engineer · Backend Engineer
introduction: I architect enterprise platforms, build AI agents that automate workflows, and engineer backend systems & SDKs that other developers build on.
about: I'm a Solution Architect who sits at the intersection of enterprise platforms, AI systems, and backend engineering — designing architectures that solve real business problems at scale.

At Iron Mountain, I architect DXP solutions, build AI agents that automate complex workflows, develop MCP servers for intelligent content interactions, and ship scalable SDKs that enable partners to integrate seamlessly.
My engineering foundation is 3+ years of shipping production backend systems — Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, database architectures, and SDK layers that other developers build on top of.
I write about what I build. My technical articles break down architecture patterns, AI agent design, and backend engineering decisions for the developer community.

experience.title: Associate Solution Architect
responsibilities: Architected and shipped a reusable SDK layer on top of Iron Mountain's DXP — now used by partners to integrate enterprise content management in days, not months
Built custom processors and platform extensions that unlocked new DXP use cases for enterprise clients with complex business workflows
Prototyped an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — enabling AI agents to interact with enterprise content, metadata, and workflows programmatically
Designed AI-powered automation pipelines that eliminated repetitive manual operations across content lifecycle management
Led technical enablement for partner engineers — running architecture walkthroughs, live demos, and integration workshops

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Owned the full AWS infrastructure stack — provisioned EC2, VPCs, security groups, and IAM via Terraform with zero-touch deployments
Automated node bootstrapping using Terraform provisioners + Ansible, reducing new server setup from hours to minutes
Built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines that handled the full lifecycle: build → test → containerize → push to ECR → deploy to ECS/Fargate
Containerized applications with Docker and established image registries on AWS ECR for production-grade deployments
Set up Grafana observability dashboards and alerting — giving the team real-time visibility into infrastructure health
Enforced Git-based workflows with branching strategies and PR reviews as standard practice

experience.title: Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Designed and shipped production Java/Spring Boot applications — REST APIs, modular service architecture, clean domain boundaries
Built full-stack features end-to-end: Thymeleaf UIs → service layer → PostgreSQL/MongoDB with Flyway-managed schema migrations
Implemented business-critical logic including real-time analytics, seat allocation algorithms, and order processing pipelines
Maintained engineering standards: version-controlled everything, documented architectural decisions, published technical write-ups

experience.title: DevOps Trainee
responsibilities: Completed intensive hands-on training in Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native infrastructure patterns
Deployed and managed multi-container applications with production-like orchestration and networking
Implemented RBAC security policies and hardened Kubernetes clusters following industry standards
Solved real-world infrastructure case studies — troubleshooting distributed systems under failure conditions
